findings.highlight: Drown me in more and more of
findings.explanation: Setsuna tells Haruki to drown in her, and to drown in her more deeply. The translation makes Setsuna ask to be drowned, reversing the desired subject and object.
findings.japanese:
「溺れて…
もっと、わたしに溺れ…んちゅぅぅぅ…ぷぁっ、
は、あ、あ…こほっ、こほっ…ん、ん～っ！」
findings.todokanai: "Drown me in it… Drown me in more and more of… nnchu, haa, haa, aah, kuh, kuh… nn, nn～!"

findings.highlight: savor even more of our mixed saliva
findings.evidenceJa: 飲み込み、飲み込ませる
findings.explanation: The source ends with one partner swallowing and making the other swallow, a reciprocal exchange. The translation reduces both directed actions to savoring mixed saliva.
findings.japanese:
そしてまた、すぐに唇を重ね、
舌を重ね、歯をぶつけ、唾液を混ぜ合わせ、
飲み込み、飲み込ませる。
findings.todokanai: And once again bring our lips together, entwine our tongues, bump our teeth every now and then, and savor even more of our mixed saliva.

findings.highlight: an aesthetically pleasing, but unassured method of treatment
findings.explanation: Setsuna chose an expensive cosmetic treatment not covered by health insurance. The translation calls it an 'unassured' treatment, turning an insurance-coverage fact into a claim about medical reliability.
findings.japanese:
その被せ物が、白いことも。
見栄張って保険の利かない治療を選んだことも。
findings.todokanai: The sparkling white on that crown. The fact that she chose an aesthetically pleasing, but unassured method of treatment.

findings.explanation: Setsuna's gaze seems to reclaim everything she herself had fled from until now. The translation makes unspecified things escape the pair, erasing her earlier avoidance and present reversal.
findings.japanese:
今まで逃げていた分を
全て取り返そうとするかのように、
俺を、深くまでえぐる。
findings.todokanai: As if trying to make up for everything that has escaped us, they pierce deeply into my heart.

findings.highlight: Make a mess of me. Don't hold back.
findings.evidenceJa: 無理やり、して。寄り道なんかしないで
findings.explanation: Setsuna explicitly asks Haruki to do it forcefully, not take detours, and come to her quickly. The translation substitutes making a mess and not holding back, obscuring the force and direct-route instructions that define the requested act.
findings.japanese:
「無理やり、して。
寄り道なんかしないで。
早く、わたしのところに来てよぉ」
findings.todokanai: "Make a mess of me. Don't hold back. Hurry up and come to me already."

findings.highlight: As I bring my hand up to her waist in an attempt to lower her stockings and underwear, Setsuna reaches for the zipper on my pants.
findings.evidenceJa:
俺が、雪菜の腰にまで手を伸ばし、
ショーツごとストッキングをずり下ろしたのを察知すると、
雪菜も、俺のズボンのファスナーに手をかける。
findings.explanation: The culmination of preparation is softened to an attempt to proceed.
findings.japanese:
俺が、雪菜の腰にまで手を伸ばし、
ショーツごとストッキングをずり下ろしたのを察知すると、
雪菜も、俺のズボンのファスナーに手をかける。
findings.todokanai: As I bring my hand up to her waist in an attempt to lower her stockings and underwear, Setsuna reaches for the zipper on my pants.

findings.evidenceJa: こんな、準備だけすぐに
findings.explanation: Setsuna marvels that although she has never had sex, her body became physically prepared so quickly. The translation mistakes that bodily readiness for foreplay and leaves the contrast incomplete.
findings.japanese:
「したこと、ないのに…
こんな、準備だけすぐに…っ」
findings.todokanai: "Even though I've never done it before… Just this foreplay was enough to…"

findings.highlight: has been preparing for it for all these years
findings.evidenceJa: その頃から身体が勝手に準備を始めてしまい
findings.explanation: Haruki speculates that Setsuna's body involuntarily began preparing from around that moment. The translation factualizes the inference and changes the onset into continuous preparation across all the intervening years.
findings.japanese:
だから雪菜は、必死でそれに応えようと、
その頃から身体が勝手に準備を始めてしまい…
findings.todokanai: And in order to answer those desires, Setsuna's body has been preparing for it for all these years…

findings.highlight: "Ah, ah… ahh～! Ii, uaah… ah… more, more…! Do it as if you were putting… three years' worth of emotions into it!"
findings.evidenceJa:
「あ、あ…っ、あ～っ！
ひ、い、ぅぁ…ぁ…もっと、もっと、ぉ…
三年分の強さで…抱きしめなくちゃならないんだよ」
findings.explanation: A release of physical strength is generalized into emotional release.
findings.japanese:
「あ、あ…っ、あ～っ！
ひ、い、ぅぁ…ぁ…もっと、もっと、ぉ…
三年分の強さで…抱きしめなくちゃならないんだよ」
findings.todokanai: "Ah, ah… ahh～! Ii, uaah… ah… more, more…! Do it as if you were putting… three years' worth of emotions into it!"

findings.explanation: Setsuna asks for the current motion to become faster and faster. 'If only you… sooner' instead reads as regret that Haruki did not act at an earlier time.
findings.japanese:
「あああんっ、あっ、あ～っ！
そ、それを、それを…
もっと、もっと早く…うあぁぁぁぁんっ」
findings.todokanai: "Aaaaaahn, aah, aaaah～! I-If, if only you… sooner, sooner… aaaahnn…"

findings.explanation: Haruki names a desire to possess or control Setsuna among his conflicting impulses. The translation turns that into sadism, adding pleasure in cruelty that the source does not assert.
findings.japanese:
体の快感と、心の痛みと、
支配欲と、罪悪感とが、
俺の中で混ざりあい、ますます雪菜を離せなくなる。
findings.todokanai: Carnal pleasures, heartache, sadistic desires, and guilt all swirl around inside me, gradually making me unable to let go of Setsuna.

findings.highlight: no one else would ever think of laying eyes on her
findings.evidenceJa: 俺以外の誰もが、もう手も触れられなくなるくらいに
findings.explanation: Haruki wants to mark Setsuna so completely that no one else could touch her. The translation changes physical touch and possession to merely looking at her.
findings.japanese:
雪菜を、汚したい。
俺以外の誰もが、もう手も触れられなくなるくらいに。
findings.todokanai: I want to… defile her. To the point where no one else would ever think of laying eyes on her.

findings.explanation: Haruki wants Setsuna to color or stain him so completely that nobody else can move his heart. The translation reverses the direction and makes him stain Setsuna.
findings.japanese:
雪菜に、染められたい。
もう、俺が誰にも心を動かされることのないくらいに。
findings.todokanai: I want to… stain her with my color. To the point where no one else would ever make my heart race again.
